OBSERVATION · INTENTION · DESIGN
01 / THE SUBJECT

This edition does not claim a verified public mailbox or live form endpoint. Contact delivery will be activated through the owned SMTP/IMAP and identity stack after independent acceptance.

01 / 02

An intentional communications boundary

Rasen Falcon is being developed as a public home and operational dogfood environment for Alchemy. An active contact channel requires its own verified DNS, authenticated mail handling, abuse controls and recipient routing.

  • A real inbox, not a decorative form
  • No collection of personal data without a receiver
  • Governed communications history
02 / 02

What to include later

Project context, required capabilities and the best way to make contact will be enough for a technical enquiry. Never send passwords, credentials or personal secrets via an unverified channel.

  • Project and use case
  • Required technical boundary
  • Preferred channel once commissioned
